classification.difficultyReason: Represent the northeast journey as a right triangle and choose sine for the east component and cosine for the north component using the given bearing.

content.prompt: Jo hikes for $369\text{ m}$ on a bearing of $053^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$ from point $A$ to point $B$. Find, correct to the nearest metre:

children.label: a
children.prompt: how far east point $B$ is from point $A$

answer.worked:
The east distance is opposite the $53^{\circ}$ angle measured from north.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{\text{Distance east}}{369}&=\sin 53^{\circ}\\\text{Distance east}&=369\sin 53^{\circ}\\\text{Distance east}&\approx295\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: how far north point $B$ is from point $A$

answer.worked:
The north distance is adjacent to the $53^{\circ}$ angle measured from north.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{\text{Distance north}}{369}&=\cos 53^{\circ}\\\text{Distance north}&=369\cos 53^{\circ}\\\text{Distance north}&\approx222\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
